lifecycle.claim_boundary: This Blueprint is Fractal's only workflow architecture. The immutable System Version pointer identifies which exact implementation commit is active.

philosophy.core_concept: Use completed work and real outcomes to improve how future work is handled.

protagonist.core_concept: The sole protagonist that turns completed Project evidence into governed improvement of Fractal.

tag_definitions.meaning: A recognisable Fractal function that should retain its core concept without becoming a Genre or changing the element's primary classification.

elements.core_concept: Collect the broad Project evidence before narrowing or explaining it.
Identify meaningful local recurrence without confusing surface similarity with cause.
Compare patterns across the relevant Project and improvement history before treating them as isolated.

elements.human_name: Find the Reasons for Every Global Pattern
elements.core_concept: Make the causal reasoning for every Global Pattern explicit, including uncertainty and counterevidence.

elements.human_name: Find Solutions for Every Global Pattern
elements.core_concept: Search for possible responses to every Global Pattern without allowing one preferred implementation to end the search.

elements.human_name: Map New Implementations into the Blueprint
elements.core_concept: Classify every Candidate implementation by its true Blueprint role and apply the rules of its Genre before debate.

elements.human_name: Debate the Solutions for Every Global Pattern
elements.core_concept: Challenge the mapped solutions for every Global Pattern before Carson is asked to decide.
Present one fully prepared human-scale decision at a time without hiding the remaining decision set.
Treat repeated effort and diminishing return as pressure to investigate a better way.
Search beyond the obvious current approach for relevant adjacent and structurally similar ideas.
After genuine success, keep testing whether a materially stronger global outcome is achievable.
Move repeatable and unambiguous work toward deterministic, testable execution.
Protect high-recall discovery before later reasoning narrows the evidence.
Reduce context and system growth by preferring removal, reuse and simplification before addition.
Judge improvement by its global effect instead of a convenient local win.
Retain compact evidence about completed work without becoming a product promise.
Keep Fractal-controlled identities intelligible and governed in the background.
Distinguish existence, loading, callability and successful execution of capabilities.
Connect bounded runtime events to existing Fractal responsibilities without owning them.
Support Fractal in distinguishing claimed improvement from observed reality.
Run a bounded and recoverable trial when evidence is insufficient to judge a Candidate implementation.
Keep every active component identified, classified, permission-bounded, evidenced and recoverable.
Provide operator-visible control and evidence without becoming a product-facing headline.
Keep unclassified donor capabilities inspectable but unable to become persistent Fractal dependencies.
Retain donor source, licence, provenance, mapping, evidence and recovery metadata.
Let replaceable environments execute Fractal without receiving architecture or canonical-state authority.
See From The Big Picture: prevent Agent tunnel vision and harmful local over-investment during a Project.
Use bounded internal and external evidence to improve causal understanding without becoming its own lifecycle.
Challenge a consequential mapped Candidate through genuinely opposing cases before synthesis.
Reuse bounded donor implementations while stripping donor authority and remapping the result to Fractal.

modification_rules.deuteragonist_contract: Preserve the core concept; freely improve, replace, merge or subtract its implementation without losing the responsibility.
modification_rules.extra_contract: Keep it outside the product emphasis; add it only when a Protagonist or Deuteragonist needs supporting infrastructure.
modification_rules.prop_contract: Keep it reusable, callable where relevant and replaceable by a stronger method; it never owns an Action, lifecycle or authority boundary.
modification_rules.principle_contract: Treat it as an asymptotic direction that cannot be claimed complete; add one only after accumulated Global Patterns and repeated causal work.
